title.narrative: Since January 2024, UNICEF and partners established 1,088 safe learning spaces, benefiting 2.25 million children (51% girls), including 219,365 adolescents joined clubs. In East Darfur, West Darfur, and the Kordofans;136,071 children received learning materials. UNICEF&39;s Learning Passport reached 64,161 children with inclusive, gamified education in Sudan and neighboring countries.
